method.tool: T3 collaborative preview, own tabs tab_e (Unity) and tab_f (native 2D); no standalone Playwright
method.determinism: Seeded Math.random only inside career creation and native steps; every native step .05*MATCH_SPEED unchanged; Unity and 2D use the same call sequence. sampleEvery (3 for visual phases, 30 for long full-match phases) only thins awaited picture sampling, never the steps.
method.pictureChecks: Each sampled Unity picture is compared with the native positions of exactly that rendered frame (v98Frame.qaNative, same elapsed). Pictures during ball flight are excluded from the position error only.
method.digest: FNV-1a over score, events, stats, fresh, minutes, postMatchReport, ratings, ballAccounting, geometry, people, finances (club balance + full ledger), development (skills, form, fresh, full playerModel incl. development/freshnessState/loadCursor/roleModel), booked fixtures; plus a hash of the complete career world (minus updated/created/savedAt)
method.limits: Desktop Chromium in T3 at about 9 fps with WebGL; no real phone, no mobile fps or battery release, no balance assessment. Touch quality only via emulated pointer:coarse.
